query: Filter the data to show only the vintage years where the Preqin Median Net IRR is greater than 12%.
code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
filtered_df = df[df['Preqin Median Net IRR'] > 12]
filtered_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)

query: Sort the data by the 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' column in descending order to identify which vintage years had the highest relative performance compared to the S&P 500.
code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
sorted_df = df.sort_values(by='LN PME Using S&P 500 TR', ascending=False)
sorted_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)

query: Group the data by 'Vintage' and calculate the average 'Preqin Median Net IRR' for each vintage year.
code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
grouped_df = df.groupby('Vintage')['Preqin Median Net IRR'].mean().reset_index()
grouped_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)

query: Create a pivot table to compare the 'Preqin Median Net IRR' and 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' for each vintage year.
code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
pivot_table = df.pivot_table(index='Vintage', values=['Preqin Median Net IRR', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'])
pivot_table.to_csv('output.csv', index=True)

query: Add a new column to the table that calculates the difference between 'Preqin Median Net IRR' and 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' to assess the outperformance of private investments over the public market for each vintage year.
code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
df['IRR vs PME Difference'] = df['Preqin Median Net IRR'] - df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR']
df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
